# loop exercise
```{r}
set.seed(42)
for ( i in seq_len (20)) {
  cube <- i^3
  print(cube)
}
for (i in seq_len(5)) {
  print(paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse = ""))
}
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42) 

cubed_nums <- c()

for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  res <- i^3
  cubed_nums <- c(cubed_nums, res)
}
print(cubed_nums)

# building a 10 course breakfast
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
nums <- seq_len(5)
break_df <- tibble()
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  num <- sample(nums, size = 1)
  row <- tibble(
    item = item,
    count = num
  )
  break_df <- bind_rows(break_df, row)
}
gt(break_df)
```
```{r}
# Practical 3 Part 2
# practice exercise
coin_toss <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"), size = 1)
print(coin_toss)
for (i in seq_len(5)) {
  coin_toss <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
    size = 1
  )
  print(coin_toss)
}

coin_tosses <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
  size = 5,
  replace = TRUE
)
print(coin_tosses)

n_successes <- sum(coin_tosses == "Heads")
print(n_successes)

coin_tosses <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
  size = 5,
  replace = TRUE,
  prob = c(0.7, 0.3)
)
print(coin_tosses)

bm_vec <- c("Badger", "Mushroom", "Snake")
bm_probs <- c(0.95, 0.04, 0.01)

my_sample <- sample(bm_vec,
  size = 100,
  replace = TRUE,
  prob = bm_probs
)
print(my_sample)
```
